entities.description: Condition where UE is operating in single-registration mode.

entities.name: 5G-GUTI

relations.description: Registration procedure may include Additional GUTI IE under specified conditions.
Inclusion of Additional GUTI IE is guarded by inter-system change condition.
Inclusion of Additional GUTI IE is guarded by single-registration mode condition.
Inclusion of Additional GUTI IE is guarded by presence of valid 5G-GUTI.
Inclusion of Additional GUTI IE is guarded by condition of holding two valid native 5G-GUTIs.
